products.name: ROVER IDPA Belt
products.summary: A 1.5-inch, articulated competition belt that is lightweight, adjustable, and built for IDPA.
products.description: The R.O.V.E.R. IDPA Belt is a standalone, 1.5-inch segmented belt designed to be printed at home and assembled with common hardware. Individual links are joined with M2 × 35 mm spring pins, then finished with a DAA ratcheting belt kit. Add or remove standard links to set the overall length, use a 0.75 link for a finer fit, and replace an individual link rather than replacing the whole belt. The current V5 links use revised hinge geometry for improved strength, lower weight, and smoother articulation; do not mix V4 and V5 links. The design stays within the current IDPA 1.75-inch width and 5/16-inch thickness limits.

products.name: ROVER USPSA Belt
products.summary: A modular ROVER belt setup configured for USPSA equipment and match-day adjustability.
products.description: The ROVER USPSA Belt uses the same articulated, serviceable link concept as the IDPA ROVER, arranged for a USPSA competition setup. Printed belt sections are connected with M2 × 35 mm spring pins, allowing the belt to be resized, repaired, or reconfigured link by link instead of being treated as one fixed piece. A ratcheting belt kit closes and tensions the assembly, while the segmented construction lets it follow the body more naturally than a solid strip. The product photos show the current arrangement; the Printables library contains the related ROVER parts, mounting plates, and accessories as they are released.

products.name: ASTRO Magazine Pouch
products.summary: A modular magnetic magazine pouch with interchangeable bodies, mounts, and cant options.
products.description: The ASTRO Magazine Pouch is the Klock Holding Co. MagDock V3 system: a magnetically retained competition pouch built from interchangeable printed bodies, mounting plates, and connectors. It mounts directly to Mini Tek-Lok or full-size Tek-Lok-compatible attachments, or pairs with KlockLok 360 for adjustable cant. The system uses common M4 hardware, M4 heat-set inserts, and an approximately 25–26 mm countersunk neodymium cup magnet, so wear parts and hardware can be replaced independently. Current tested configurations include Glock full-size 9 mm magazines, standard 1911 magazines, and optional spacers to tune the fit for the magazine geometry.

products.name: GROMIT Magnet Attachment
products.summary: A compact magnetic magazine holder for make-ready and other competition-use positions.
products.description: The GROMIT Magnetic Mag Holder is an administrative, magnet-retained holder for a make-ready magazine or another non-retention-critical competition position. Its PETG inner body carries the magnet and mounting load, while the TPU outer shell protects the assembly from impacts and wear. It attaches to a Mini 2-Hole Tek-Lok-compatible mount with M4 hardware. Use one 32 mm countersunk neodymium cup magnet for most steel-bodied magazines, or two magnets for Glock polymer-bodied magazines where less steel is exposed. It is intended for competition and administrative handling—not duty, field, or concealed-carry retention.
